results.text: Living together early scares me for a very unromantic reason. Once two people share rent, a bedroom, furniture, maybe a pet, slowing the relationship down becomes a practical mess. Sometimes housing means you don't have much choice. But if I do have a choice, I don't want logistics deciding that the relationship continues. I also want a date when we ask each other how it's going before the answer is already a crisis.
